```{r prepare metadata}
cross_ids <-
    id_check_tb %>% 
      `colnames<-`(make.unique(colnames(.))) %>% ## this step rename duplicated columns str_c(colnames(id_check_tb)[id_check_tb %>% colnames() %>% duplicated()], sep = ',')
      dplyr::filter(str_starts(DNUBiolSampleID, 'DN')) %>%
      pivot_longer(c(NHLBI.iPSC.1, NHLBI.iPSC.2), values_to = 'NHLBI_id', names_to = 'temp') %>%
      mutate(
        NHLBI_id =NHLBI_id,
        DNU_id = case_when(DNUBiolSampleID == Blood.id ~ DNUBiolSampleID, TRUE ~ 'mismatch'),
        FCL_id = Fibroblast.id,
        NYSCF_id = case_when(str_ends(temp, '1') &  NYSCF.iPSC.1 == NPC.1 ~ NYSCF.iPSC.1, 
                             str_ends(temp, '2') &  NYSCF.iPSC2 == NPC.2 ~ NYSCF.iPSC2, TRUE ~ 'mismatch'),
        Karyotype = Dx,
        Biopsy = Study,
        Age = Age,
        .keep = 'none') %>%
      dplyr::filter(NYSCF_id != 'CF0013-04') # discontinued

ipsc_ids <- 
   id_sca_project %>% 
      dplyr::filter(str_starts(Short.ID, '^[\\d]+$')) %>%
      mutate(NHLBI_id = str_remove_all(Derived.from, '[()]'),
          #   NYSCF_id = str_extract(`CF.#`, '^[^-]*-[^-]*'), # so many inconsistencies I'll exclude this double check for now
             SCA_id = paste0('SCA', str_pad(Short.ID, width = 2, side = 'left', pad = 0)),
             Karyotype = Dx,
             Batch = Batch,
             Seed_pass = str_extract(`Seeding.passage.#`, '^[^ ]+') %>% as.numeric(),
             Harvest_pass = str_extract(`Freezing.passage.#`, '^[^ ]+') %>% as.numeric(),
             .keep = 'none') 

fcl_ids <- 
  colData(fcl_dds) %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>%
    mutate(DNU_id = str_sub(Sample, end = 9L),
           FCL_karyotype = Group,
           FCL_age = Age,
           .keep = 'none')

passages <- 
  up_passage %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Cohort == 'Aneuploidy' & iPSC_status != 'Discontinued' & iPSC_status != 'Did not pass') %>%
    mutate(NYSCF_id = NYSCF_ID,
           NHLBI_id = if_else(NYSCF_ID == 'CF0037-04', 'HT946A', NIMH_ID),
           Karyotype = `Mutation_/_Genotype`,
           Monoclonization = if_else(`Monoclonalization?` == 'Pass', 'yes', 'no'),
           Initial_pass = as.numeric(`Passage_#_at_Arrival`),

           Sample_Type = Sample_Type,

           NYSCF_lot = `Lot_#`,
           .keep = 'none'
           )
```

```{r make meta }

sca_meta <-
  left_join(
    cross_ids , 
    ipsc_ids ,
    by = c(intersect(colnames(cross_ids),colnames(ipsc_ids))) 
    ) %>% 
  left_join(
    fcl_ids,
    by = c(intersect(colnames(.), colnames(fcl_ids)))
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    passages,
    by = c(intersect(colnames(.), colnames(passages)))
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    Scaled_age = scale(Age),
    Centered_age = scale(Age, scale = FALSE, center = TRUE),
    gonSex = ifelse(str_detect(Karyotype, 'Y'), 'Male', 'Female'),
    is_SCA = ifelse (Karyotype %in% c('XY' ,'XX'), 'Euploid', 'Aneuploid'),
    XCD = str_count(Karyotype, 'X'),
    YCD = str_count(Karyotype, 'Y'),
    SCD = str_count(Karyotype, 'X|Y')
  )
```

```{r chr location label fx}

label.chr <- function(gr, bed) {
  chr <- as.character(seqnames(gr))
  reg <- ifelse(chr == "chrM", "chrM",
         ifelse(chr == "chrX", "X-linked",
         ifelse(chr == "chrY", "Y-linked", "Autosomal"))) #Default labels
  bed_gr <- rtracklayer::import(bed)   # Import PAR bed file form chm13 github
  bed_chr <- as.character(seqnames(bed_gr)) # Infer PAR1/PAR2 separately for X and Y
  bed_start <- start(bed_gr)
  par_names <- character(length(bed_gr))
   # For each chromosome, identify PAR1 (earlier) vs PAR2 (later)
  for (chr_name in unique(bed_chr)) {
    idx <- which(bed_chr == chr_name)
    if (length(idx) == 2) {
      # Assume earlier region is PAR1, later is PAR2
      par_names[idx] <- c("PAR1", "PAR2")[order(bed_start[idx])]
    } else if (length(idx) == 1) {
      # Only one PAR region - assume PAR1
      par_names[idx] <- "PAR1"
    }
  }
  mcols(bed_gr)$par_name <- par_names
  overlaps <- findOverlaps(gr, bed_gr)   # Find overlaps
  
  if (length(overlaps) > 0) {
    within <- findOverlaps(gr, bed_gr, type = "within")     # Within PAR
    reg[queryHits(within)] <- par_names[subjectHits(within)]
    all_overlap <- unique(queryHits(overlaps))    
    border <- setdiff(all_overlap, queryHits(within))  # Border
    
    if (length(border) > 0) {
      border_overlaps <- overlaps[queryHits(overlaps) %in% border]
      reg[queryHits(border_overlaps)] <- paste0(
        par_names[subjectHits(border_overlaps)], "_border"
      )}
  }
  
  return(reg)
}

```

```{r add gene info}
# Chromosomic location
mcols(t2t_se)$chr_loc <- 
  label.chr(gr = rowRanges(t2t_se), bed = here('chm13v2.0_PAR.bed'))

mcols(t2t_se)$short_loc <-
  if_else(str_detect(mcols(t2t_se)$chr_loc, 'PAR'), 'PAR', mcols(t2t_se)$chr_loc)

mcols(t2t_se)$Balaton <- 
  data.frame(n = Balaton_name, s = Balaton_syn) %>% 
    tidyr::unite('B', n, s) %>% 
    mutate(B = str_remove(B, 'NA_|_NA|_No call|No call_'),
           B = str_replace(B, 'S_S', 'S')) %>%
    pull(B)

mcols(t2t_se)$Gylemo <-
  data.frame(n = Gylemo_name, s = Gylemo_syn) %>% 
    tidyr::unite('B', n:s) %>% 
    mutate(B = str_remove_all(B, 'NA_|_NA'),
```

###
###
  
  
  # Determine arm for each gene based on centromere position
  chr <- as.character(seqnames(rowranges))
  
  # Initialize vectors
  arm <- character(length(rowranges))
  tel_distance <- numeric(length(rowranges))
  
  for (i in seq_along(rowranges)) {
    gene_chr <- chr[i]
    gene_tss <- tss[i]
    
    # Get centromere for this chromosome
    
    cent <- centromeres[centromeres$chr == gene_chr, ]
    
    if (nrow(cent) == 0) {
      arm[i] <- NA
      tel_distance[i] <- NA
      next
    }
    
    # Determine arm
    if (gene_tss < cent$start[1]) {
      arm[i] <- "p"
      # Distance to p-arm telomere (chromosome start)
      tel <- telomeres[telomeres$chr == gene_chr, ][1, ]
      tel_distance[i] <- abs(gene_tss - tel$end)
    } else {
      arm[i] <- "q"
      # Distance to q-arm telomere (chromosome end)
      tel <- telomeres[telomeres$chr == gene_chr, ][2, ]
      tel_distance[i] <- abs(gene_tss - tel$start)
    }
  }
  
  # Add annotations to rowranges
  mcols(rowranges)$tss <- tss
  mcols(rowranges)$arm <- arm
  mcols(rowranges)$telomere_distance <- tel_distance
  
  return(rowranges)
}

# snp-based swap fix: SCA06 -> SCA01 # however i'll filter it in the next step, so I can skip 
swap_fix <- function(df, target_id, source_id, id_col = 'SCA_id') {
  cols_to_replace <- setdiff(names(df), id_col)
  target_row <- which(df[[id_col]] == target_id)
  source_row <- which(df[[id_col]] == source_id)
  df[target_row, cols_to_replace] <- df[source_row, cols_to_replace]
  df
}
